entry: Each parent strategy retains its frozen Entry; SP39 retains unchanged Entry.

exit.B02: First completed M15 profit-to-nonprofit giveback only when boundary index is 1 through 16; otherwise original 48-bar Exit.
exit.F05: Frozen C2 exact 60-second Exit when its frozen state is true; otherwise original F05 Exit.

permission: For B02 A2 and F05 C2 only, block a new Entry after two consecutive realized losses in the active UTC session; reset at UTC session boundary or realized winner. SP39 is not blocked by this control.
information_time: Only completed M15 observations and realized closes available before the Entry decision; no future information or outcome label.

source.B02_F05: Rakuten MT4 immutable 2025H1 baseline audit plus frozen F05 C2 ledger
source.SP39: Rakuten M15 HST frozen period contract at fixed spread 5 points

concurrency: Existing strategy ownership and concurrency contracts retained; Round B session control affects parent Entry permission only.
priority: Process matured closes before same-timestamp Entry decisions.
position_restoration: Required in selected Core implementation; not altered by economic replay.
restart_behavior: Required to reconstruct owned parent positions and current session-loss state from owned order history.
